items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Horace Silver was one of my favorite writers at the time. I just liked the way he wrote.

ctx.x: I got the look. Since you are writing and now arranging, do you have any influences that you can credit as far as your conceptions at that point?
Not at that point, no. I was just trying things. See if this works and that works. I think Horace Silver was one of my favorite writers at the time. I just liked the way he
wrote. Everything was so melodic and catchy and memorable. Everything was memorable. It wasn’t too slick. Everything was very memorable.
